items.title: Don Menza and Sam Noto interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 28, 1997
items.q: I was on two tours I made with Basie. ‘64 and ‘65 I think it was.

ctx.x: I was on two tours I made with Basie. ‘64 and ‘65 I think it was. Great man. I loved him, man, Basie. He never wasted any words, and just the way he played, just the way he was you know. If he liked you man he liked you. And he seemed to like me for some reason. We got along great. I thought he was a great musician too. He never got in the way. I
used to play solos on “April in Paris” and all of that stuff and he hit the chord just when you needed it, man, never overplayed.
